core: Leading-edge actin protrusion in cell migration
qualifier: WAVE/WASP and Arp2/3-driven
name: WAVE/Arp2/3-driven lamellipodial protrusion in cell migration
rationale: All members concern actin-driven protrusion at the leading edge (lamellipodia, pseudopodia, ruffles, spreading, motility), and the Arp2/3 nucleation and WASP/WAVE activation members separate it from confusables built on actin severing/capping, CDC42/IQGAP and focal-adhesion turnover, or macropinocytosis/podosomes.

qualifier: with dietary selenium compound metabolism
name: Methionine cycle, salvage and dietary selenium metabolism
rationale: Members centre on methionine/S-adenosylmethionine metabolism and methylthioadenosine salvage (MAT1A, AHCY defects, folate and neural tube links), and the selenomethionine/selenite metabolism members, absent from every confusable, distinguish it from folate-cycle, choline/carnitine and MTR/MTRR remethylation themes.

qualifier: homologous recombination, SSA and MMEJ with BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 defects
name: Resection-dependent double-strand break repair and BRCA/PALB2 defects
rationale: All members involve DSB end resection and the repair routes that depend on it (HR with D-loop resolution, single-strand annealing, MMEJ) or their BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 defects, unlike confusables centred on DSB sensing, ATM signalling, classical NHEJ and PARP/ADP-ribosylation.

qualifier: at ER membrane contact sites
name: Phospholipid transfer at ER membrane contact sites
rationale: Members cover non-vesicular phospholipid (PI/PC) transfer between the ER and other membranes plus ER positioning and ER-plasma membrane tethering, distinguishing it from ER tubular-network shaping, sphingolipid metabolism, flippase translocation and glycolipid transport.

qualifier: to lysosomes and lysosome-related organelles
name: Trans-Golgi clathrin sorting to lysosomes and lysosome-related organelles
rationale: Members describe TGN clathrin-coated vesicle biogenesis and cargo loading that delivers lysosomal enzymes and builds melanosomes and platelet dense granules, whereas confusables concern endosome-to-Golgi retrograde traffic or COPI intra-Golgi/Golgi-to-ER transport.

qualifier: NK cell differentiation and proliferation
name: IL-15 and IL-21 signaling in NK cell development
rationale: All members are IL-15/IL-21 common-gamma-chain signaling or the NK cell differentiation and proliferation it drives, distinguishing the theme from IL-2/IL-7/IL-9 T-cell, IL-10/IL-12/IL-23 and IL-3/IL-5 cytokine themes.

qualifier: classical and lectin/ficolin initiation to C3/C5 and opsonization
name: Classical and lectin complement activation and opsonization
rationale: Members cover initiation of the complement cascade via antibody (classical), lectin/ficolin and GZMK routes through C3/C5 activation and opsonization, whereas confusables centre on the alternative pathway and on negative regulation of complement.

qualifier: with restraint of IL-8 and MCP-1 production
name: Myeloid proinflammatory chemokine response and IL-8/MCP-1 restraint
rationale: Members describe inflammatory cytokine and chemokine output of myeloid and dendritic cells and its regulation (IL-8, MCP-1, chronic inflammation), distinguishing it from monocyte activation/chemotaxis/extravasation themes and from lymphocyte TNF/IL-23/NF-kB activation modules.

qualifier: via FRS2, SHC and PLC-gamma adaptors
name: FRS2, SHC and PLC-gamma cascades downstream of FGFR1/FGFR2
rationale: All members are adaptor-mediated (FRS, SHC, PLC) cascades from FGFR1 or FGFR2, separating the theme from FGFR4/betaKlotho, FGFR mutant activation, ligand-binding and PI3K-cascade themes.

qualifier: calcium-dependent, for glutamate and GABA
name: Presynaptic calcium-dependent modulation of glutamate and GABA release
rationale: Members regulate presynaptic calcium, vesicle exocytosis, short-term potentiation and glutamate/GABA secretion, distinguishing the theme from vesicle fusion/docking and transmitter release cycles and from G-protein/kainate-mediated presynaptic inhibition.

core: Neural control of locomotor and sensorimotor behavior
qualifier: including glycinergic inhibitory transmission
name: Neural control of locomotor and sensorimotor behavior, glycinergic inhibition
rationale: Most members are motor and sensory behaviors (walking, swimming, righting reflex, proprioception, grooming) with supporting neural circuitry (Purkinje layer, amygdala, inhibitory transmission), and the glycinergic/hyperekplexia and motor members distinguish it from vocalization/social learning and neuronal excitability themes.

qualifier: peptide antigen by dendritic cells, monocytes and B/plasma cells
name: MHC class II peptide antigen presentation by professional APCs
rationale: Members are MHC class II peptide loading and presentation plus surface signatures of dendritic cells, monocytes and plasma cells, distinguishing the theme from B cell identity, T cell costimulation and CD1/MHC Ib lipid antigen and NKT themes.

qualifier: in mesoderm specification and heart morphogenesis
name: BMP-SMAD signaling regulation in mesoderm and heart morphogenesis
rationale: Members pair positive and negative regulation of BMP/SMAD signaling with mesoderm fate, pericardium, coronary vasculogenesis and heart morphogenesis, whereas confusables concern second heart field/cardiomyocyte, trabeculation or endothelial/vascular differentiation without the BMP regulatory core.

qualifier: with glycerol and alditol metabolism
name: Fructose, glycerol and alditol metabolism
rationale: Members cover fructose synthesis and catabolism with its inherited disorders and the linked glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate and polyol metabolism, distinguishing the theme from galactose, gluconeogenesis/alanine and pentose/glucuronate themes.

core: Cellular osmotic and salt stress response
qualifier: with sodium and potassium transport regulation
name: Cellular osmotic stress response and sodium-potassium transport regulation
rationale: Members combine hyper-/hypo-osmotic and salt stress responses, water homeostasis and regulation of Na+/K+/Cl- transport, distinguishing it from vasopressin-aquaporin renal water handling and aldosterone-driven sodium restriction themes.

core: Oxidative metabolism of arachidonate and fatty acids
qualifier: by lipoxygenase and cytochrome P450 enzymes
name: Lipoxygenase and P450 eicosanoid and fatty acid oxidation
rationale: Members cover lipoxygenase and P450 epoxygenase/omega-hydroxylase production and turnover of eicosanoids (HETEs, EETs, leukotrienes, lipoxins, hepoxilins) and related fatty acid oxidation, distinguishing it from eicosanoid receptor signaling themes and from omega-3 resolvin/protectin biosynthesis.

qualifier: defensins, antimicrobial peptides and mucosal innate immunity
name: Defensin and antimicrobial peptide defense at mucosal surfaces
rationale: Members describe direct microbe killing and control by defensins, antimicrobial peptides, metal sequestration, cytolysis and mucosal innate responses, distinguishing the theme from neutrophil degranulation/respiratory burst, intestinal epithelial maintenance and bacterial invasion themes.

qualifier: HSF1 heat shock response and AKT-regulated FOXO
name: HSF1 heat shock response and AKT-regulated FOXO transcription
rationale: Members cover HSF1 activation and attenuation, protein refolding and heat acclimation together with AKT/acetylation control of FOXO-driven death and stress genes, distinguishing the theme from ER UPR/integrated stress response and NRF2/p53 metabolic stress themes.

qualifier: 43S scanning, eIF2/eIF3 and 60S joining
name: Eukaryotic translation initiation and 80S ribosome assembly
rationale: Members follow initiation from free 40S, eIF2 ternary and 43S complex formation, scanning and start-codon recognition to 60S joining, distinguishing it from translation termination, mRNA surveillance/ribosome rescue and Pol I/III transcription themes.

qualifier: through PTPN11, PI3K/AKT and RAP1/RAC1
name: MET receptor signaling to PTPN11, PI3K/AKT and RAP1/RAC1
rationale: All three members are MET-triggered effector branches, distinguishing the theme from MET-integrin/PTK2/tensin adhesion signaling and from FGFR, EGFR/ERBB2 and generic PI3K/AKT themes.

qualifier: driving convergent extension
name: Planar cell polarity-driven convergent extension
rationale: All members concern Wnt/PCP establishment of planar polarity and the convergent extension it drives in gastrulation, axis elongation, neural plate and organogenesis, unlike confusables about axial mesoderm, neural plate patterning and dorsoventral specification.

qualifier: including inherited absorption and processing defects
name: Cobalamin uptake, transport and cofactor processing
rationale: Members cover dietary B12 absorption (CBLIF, cubilin/amnionless), plasma transport and cellular uptake (TCN2, CD320) and intracellular processing (MMACHC, MMADHC, ABCD4) with their defects, distinguishing it from methylmalonyl-CoA mutase/propionyl-CoA and other B-vitamin themes.

Members split into unrelated groups (tight-junction paracellular and magnesium transport, inositol transport and metabolism, and generic protein oligomerization and ER membrane insertion) with no single biological theme true of all of them.

core: Nucleic acid sensing driving type I interferon
qualifier: endosomal TLR3/7/8/9 and cGAS-STING in dendritic cells
name: Endosomal TLR and cGAS-STING nucleic acid sensing in dendritic cells
rationale: Members cover endosomal TLR trafficking and TLR7/8/9 signaling, cGAS-STING regulation, their inherited HSE deficiencies and resulting dendritic cell IFN and cytokine production, distinguishing the theme from RIG-I/ISG antiviral response and TBK1-IRF3 regulation themes.

core: Histidine and histamine metabolism and signaling
qualifier: with proton-coupled peptide/histidine transport
name: Histidine-histamine metabolism and proton-coupled peptide/histidine transport
rationale: Members cover histidine catabolism, histamine metabolism, receptors and responses together with proton-coupled oligopeptide/histidine transporters, distinguishing the theme from general amino acid transporter and membrane-transport themes.
